% A test for tex8web: which tcolorbox boxes get a link at their title. A
% numbered theorem, labelled or not, a box numbered by step and a labelled
% box do, where a \ref to them leads; an unnumbered theorem, a box in a
% raster (which numbers its boxes for itself) and a box without a title
% don't. A numbered or labelled box holding another keeps its own link,
% \ref and number. A boxed title at the left, in the middle and at the
% right has its link beside it (labelled, for the link). A \tcbox on line,
% with a title or in a box, stays in its line; one with tcolorbox's space
% around it doesn't. (Its table of
% contents gives test:visual's filter check a box to find)
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\newtcbtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}{}{thm}
\newcounter{exercise}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{Boxes}
\begin{theorem}{Labelled}{one}A numbered theorem.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Unlabelled}{}Another.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem*}{Unnumbered}{}An unnumbered theorem.\end{theorem*}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title=Labelled box, label=box]A labelled box.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[step=exercise, title=Exercise]A box numbered by step.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcbraster}[raster columns=2]
\begin{tcolorbox}[title=In a raster]A box in a raster.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title=Also in a raster]Another.\end{tcolorbox}
\end{tcbraster}
\begin{tcolorbox}[label=untitled]A labelled box without a title.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{theorem}{Outer}{outer}A labelled theorem holding another:
\begin{theorem}{Inner}{}A numbered theorem in it.\end{theorem}
\end{theorem}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title=Outer box, label=outerbox]A labelled box holding another:
\begin{tcolorbox}[title=Inner box, label=innerbox]A labelled box in it.\end{tcolorbox}
\end{tcolorbox}
\tcbset{boxed/.style={enhanced, leftrule=2mm, attach boxed title to top #1, label=boxed-#1}}
\begin{tcolorbox}[boxed=left, title=Boxed left]A boxed title at the left.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[boxed=center, title=Boxed center]A boxed title in the middle.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[boxed=right, title=Boxed right]A boxed title at the right.\end{tcolorbox}
See Theorem~\ref{thm:one} and the box~\ref{box}; Theorem~\ref{thm:outer}, the
outer box~\ref{outerbox} and the inner box~\ref{innerbox}.

A word \tcbox[on line]{boxed} in its line, \tcbox[on line,title=T]{titled}
one too, and \tcbox{alone} on lines of its own.
\begin{tcolorbox}And \tcbox[nobeforeafter]{one} in a box.\end{tcolorbox}
\end{document}
